hypothesis: The blurriness of generative model outputs is inversely proportional to the discriminative capability of the discriminator model in adversarial training
prediction: Increasing discriminator classification accuracy by 20% will reduce generative output blurriness by 15%
measurement_method: Measure output blurriness using a Laplacian variance metric before and after discriminator accuracy increase
falsification_condition: If the observed blurriness reduction is less than 7.5% or greater than 30%
